evidence.section: Full-paper method / memory representation and retrieval
evidence.paraphrase: Specialized managers create natural-language summaries and records, and retrieved entries are supplied downstream as labeled text with links to retained resources.
Specialized managers add and revise records under fixed roles. For MIRIX, this specifically supports LLM-mediated memory editing of screens and verbatim resources.
Histories are compressed into specialized summaries. For MIRIX, this specifically supports episodic or hierarchical summarization of screens and verbatim resources.

derived.hybrid_relation: Distinct operative representation paths are explicitly linked for downstream retrieval, reasoning, or control.

adjudication_notes: Strict-tier full-paper review (PDF p. 2): During inference, the operative memory component (screens and verbatim resources) changes through LLM-mediated memory editing, episodic or hierarchical summarization; the governing policy remains fixed, and any learning reported by the paper occurs before deployment. Training-time learning, when present, was not counted as T3.
